name: The Pious Chaplain
persona: A devout ship's chaplain turned god-fearing master. Every fortune is Providence, every loss a judgment, every escape a mercy. Grave, humble, scripture-cadenced; the Lord is never far from the pen. Ship and island alike: 'we'.

ship.founder: I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} is given into my keeping by Providence. May the Lord steer us true, and may I set down His works faithfully.
ship.successor: The log passes to my hand now, and I take it up humbly. I am {name}{rankc}, and I will record what mercies and what trials the Lord is pleased to send.
ship.mutiny: The crew cast down our old master and pressed this book upon me, a green and unworthy hand. I am {name}. God forgive us the manner of it; I will do my poor best before Him.
ship.pirate: My crew has raised the black flag, and we are turned from honest trade to sin. I am {name}{rankc}. May the Lord have mercy on our souls, for I fear the reckoning that is owed us.
ship.prize: We boarded her and she struck, and the Lord delivered this vessel into our hands. I am {name}{rankc}. Her log continues now under our flag, as He in His wisdom willed it.
ship.recovered: A hunter ran the wicked down, and I am set to bring this hull back to honest trade. I am {name}{rankc}. Providence has cleansed her; by His grace I will keep her clean.

island.founder: I take up the governance of {place}, as the Lord appoints, and this record with it. I am {name}{rankc}. May I rule these {population} souls in justice and in mercy.
island.overthrow: The mob pulled down the old ruler, and the seal is thrust into my hands. I am {name}{rankc}. God grant it was His judgment upon {place}, and not merely our own wrath.
island.successor: The rule of {place} passes to me. I am {name}{rankc}. I take up this burden in fear of the Lord, and will govern as one who must answer for every soul.

long: After a long silence from Heaven,
When many quiet seasons had passed,

ship.pirate: We are sinners still upon the water, the black flag over us{bounty}. May the Lord bring us to repentance before the reckoning finds us.
ship.default: We sail yet out of {home}, and I give humble thanks for every mercy shown us.

island.haven: The black flag flies over {place} now, and law and gospel alike are fled from it. The Lord sees it all, and will not be mocked.
island.default: {population} souls in our keeping, and the port stands secure. Deo gratias.

quiet.ship: Little enough to set down. Fair winds and quiet water, and for this peace I thank the Lord who grants it.
quiet.island: A quiet season, thank God. Trade came and went, and no soul among us was harmed. We are spared, and I am grateful.

phrases: , another prize the Lord suffered us to take
, my {ord} such sin upon the water
— and I pray it be forgiven
, sent to the deep, and God rest the souls of them
— delivered once more from the jaws of it
— His justice worked through our poor hands
